subject: Drone photography window + placard mounting plan / crate labeling
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@expoevents.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Drone window & on-floor placard placements for CloudCon

Hi Hannah,

Quick one as we finalize the operations schedule: the venue team has a 30-minute multirotor window on the morning of Tuesday 9/12 (07:30-08:00) for aerial coverage of island booths. We need confirmation that Redwood is OK with a drone pass over the booth footprint, and we also need final placard mounting heights and locations for compliance with the venue sightline rules.

Can you confirm:
- OK for the drone overflight (we require a signed waiver; we can route the DocSend link once you sign)
- Where around the booth you want the 3 directional placards pinned (we need approximate distances to edges and whether they mount to the backwall or freestanding poles)
- Any special crate-labeling instructions for freight partners to ensure staging goes to Bay 6 (we get a lot of misrouted crates)

If you want, FastPrint (cc'd) can pre-produce placard proofs; Alex at CrateFreight can pre-print the adhesive crate labels.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lang
Senior Events Producer | ExpoEvents
[Attachment: venue_drone_policy.pdf (PDF)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@expoevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Drone window & on-floor placard placements for CloudCon

On Tue, Jun 20, 2028 at 9:12 AM Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@expoevents.com> wrote:
> Quick one as we finalize the operations schedule: the venue team has a 30-minute multirotor window on the morning of Tuesday 9/12 (07:30-08:00) for aerial coverage of island booths.

Thanks, Sophie — we can accommodate the morning drone pass. Please send the DocSend waiver and I will get it signed by legal tomorrow. A few clarifications from our side:

- Drone: Approved for the 07:30-08:00 window as long as the pilot stays to the aisle side of our island. We do not want the craft to hover directly above our demo counters or racks. Please confirm pilot insurance limits (standard +1M liability).

- Placards: we want three directional placards: two aisle-facing on the long sides and one entry placard on the corner pedestal. Mounting: prefer 36 inches from finished floor to center (placard_specs_v2.pdf attached) and use freestanding poles for the two aisle ones rather than backwall mounting to avoid tape on fabric. FastPrint, please produce them in matte lam for glare reduction.

- Crate labeling / routing: Please apply the attached CSV (crate_labels_CLOUDCON.csv) to each crate as a peel-and-stick barcode label. The label must include: Redwood account code, booth ID C12, crate sequence (1/N) and Bay 6 delivery window tag. Alex, can you confirm your team can prioritize Bay 6?

I have attached floorplan_v3.pdf — note we shifted the demo counter 18" to the left to open a clear camera corridor for the drone flyby. Marissa, Kim, Soojin — any red flags on the placement?

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: floorplan_v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Drone window & on-floor placard placements for CloudCon

Thanks Hannah — quick internal note:

- Placard material: can we switch the poles to a telescoping aluminum (lighter for install) instead of the heavier steel? Same visual, less crew time.
- Counter shift: Confirmed — moving 18" is fine but it reduces demo staging space; we'll need one fewer sample on the demo counter stack. I'll update the handheld checklist.
- Crate labels: I noticed the CSV uses "C12" but our booth is listed as "C-12" in the venue manifest. For clarity on the shipping side let's include both variants on the label (primary: C12; alt_manifest: C-12).

Proposed next step: Kim can approve the print spec and we push proofs to FastPrint by end of day Friday so we can sign off Monday.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: placard_specs_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: FastPrint Co. <printshop@fastprint.co>, Alex Romero <alex@cratefreight.com>, Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@expoevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Drone window & on-floor placard placements for CloudCon

All — final approvals: thanks for the quick turn.

- Drone waiver: Sophie — we received the DocSend link and legal signed it (linked in related_links). Pilot insurance confirmed at 2M liability. OK to proceed with the 07:30-08:00 window. Please ensure pilot stays aisle-side as discussed.

- Placards: Kimberly, you OK to move forward with the telescoping aluminum poles? If yes, FastPrint please produce 3 placards per the specs (matte lam, 24x18) and send proofs to kimberly_park@redwood.com. Ship proofs to our SF office (address in Drive) for a hard-check.

- Crate labeling / routing: Alex — please apply the updated CSV labels (we added alt_manifest field, see attachments) and confirm Bay 6 priority; also confirm ETA for arrival to Bay 6 on 9/10.

Action items:
1) FastPrint: send digital proofs to Kimberly by 2028-06-30.
2) Alex/CrateFreight: confirm Bay 6 slot and provide ETA by 2028-06-29.
3) Sophie/ExpoEvents: confirm pilot will maintain aisle-side pass and share signed waiver confirmation to the venue ops channel.

I'll follow up Monday for status.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
[Attachments: placard_specs_v2.pdf (PDF), crate_labels_CLOUDCON.csv (CSV)]
